title: A day on Venus is longer than its year
hook: One spin of Venus takes longer than its whole trip around the Sun.

lines.say: A day on Venus is longer than its year.
Venus spins so slowly that one turn on its axis takes two hundred and forty-three Earth days.
lines.say_digits: one turn on its axis takes 243 Earth days.

lines.say: But one trip around the Sun takes only about two hundred and twenty-five.
And it spins backwards. So if you could see through the clouds, the Sun would rise in the west.
Follow for more facts that sound fake, but aren't.

caption:
A day on Venus is longer than its year. 🪐

Venus turns so slowly that one spin on its axis takes about 243 Earth days. One trip around the Sun takes only about 225.

And it spins backwards. If you could see through its thick clouds, you'd watch the Sun rise in the west and set in the east.

Which fact got you: the day or the sunrise? 👇
